article.story: MUNCIE, Ind. -- — Berry Wallace scored 22 points, Jasmine Brown-Hagger added 18 and No. 21 Illinois used a 19-0 run in the first half to defeat Ball State 91-51 on Wednesday night. Reserve Maddie Webber, who had all 13 of her points in the first half on 6-of-7 shooting, had five points as Illinois scored the last 11 points of the first quarter to take a 26-14 lead. Then Illinois scored the first eight of the second quarter to make it 34-14. Illinois led 48-23 at the half. Aaliyah Guyton had 15 points and Gretchen Dolan 12 for the Illini (4-0), who made 8 of 16 3-pointers and shot 54% (34 of 63) from the field and 84% (15 of 18) from the foul line. Grace Kingery scored 12 points and Zhen Verburgt 11 for the Cardinals (1-3), who were 2 of 15 behind the arc and shot 26% overall (15 of 57). From the point where Verburgt converted a three-point play to put the Cardinals within 15-14 they missed 11-straight shots and went 1 of 18 the rest of the first half with 11 turnovers. The Cardinals played the Illini even again in the third quarter but were outscored 16-2 in the first half of the fourth quarter. Up next Illinois: Against Marquette at the Baha Mar Hoops Nassau Championship in Bahamas No. 27. Ball State: At UIC on Saturday. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full college basketball coverage here
